title: NoSQLServer selected SQLite editorial ledger
summary: CmsWebsiteSnapshotStore.cls selects SQLiteWritableDatabaseEngine from NoSQLServer v0.90. Every revision is a single prepared INSERT with expected prior revision; load/history/verify are local CLI operations.
invariants: Single authorised local writer; v0.90 is a development candidate with no multi-statement transaction API or predicate-wide multi-writer serialisability.

Newer v0.91 SHA-256: d4a276007029e66512611ea7e836ca7ab30209b80ac7d46ecf1fba61121f02d0; it adds opt-in single-table UPDATE/DELETE predicate validation, not new multi-statement transactions. Version upgrade requires independent Publisher qualification.
NoSQLServer source remains separate pinned dependency; do not copy into owned GitHub tree.
Potential crash/cleanup of WAL snapshot temporary files, resource caps, storage volume permissions and post-commit refresh warning handling remain deployment obligations.

provenance.claim: Exact complete v0.3 publisher distribution used for source inventory and regression suite
